name: aven
title: Aven
description: Raycast extension for the aven task manager.
author: Infonautica

commands.name: add-task
commands.title: Add Task
commands.description: Adds a new task to specified Workspace and project in aven CLI

preferences.name: defaultWorkspace
preferences.title: Default Workspace
preferences.description: Workspace key to preselect when adding a task. Falls back to the first available workspace if not found.

preferences.name: defaultProject
preferences.title: Default Project
preferences.description: Project key to preselect when adding a task. Falls back to the first available project in the selected workspace if not found.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
